question:
List all patients with their sex and date of birthday, whose AST glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (GOT) index is within normal range for loboratory examination in 1994.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: AST glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (GOT) index is within normal range refers to GOT < 60; examination in 1994 refers to year(Date) = 1994

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_058, p.XCL_059, p.XCL_060
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE l.XCL_016 < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1994';
